key: PIERCE: I am very tired.
en: PIERCE: I am very tired.
ja: ピアース：オレはひどく疲れてる。

key: I've raged with the Aqua Gang for so long.
en: I've raged with the Aqua Gang for so long.
ja: アクアギャングでずっと暴れ回ってきたからな。

key: Now I just wish to sit here and stare at the water in silence.
en: Now I just wish to sit here and stare at the water in silence.
ja: 今はただ、ここに座って黙って水を眺めていたいだけなんだ。

key: This must be what getting old feels like.
en: This must be what getting old feels like.
ja: これが歳を取るってことなんだろうな。

key: It's not as bad as I'd thought.
en: It's not as bad as I'd thought.
ja: 思ってたほど悪くない。

key: Geez, I can't take this anymore...
en: Geez, I can't take this anymore...
ja: ああもう、これ以上耐えられねえ……

key: When Kiki was around, everything was so relaxed,
en: When Kiki was around, everything was so relaxed,
ja: キキがいたころは、何もかもがゆるかったのに、

key: But Victoria's doubled our training routines and she's been pushing us to the limit!
en: But Victoria's doubled our training routines and she's been pushing us to the limit!
ja: ヴィクトリアはオレたちの訓練メニューを倍にして、限界まで追い込んでくるんだ!

key: She says that's the only way to break our limits, but can't we have a break?!
en: She says that's the only way to break our limits, but can't we have a break?!
ja: それが限界を突破する唯一の方法だって言うけど、少しくらい休ませてくれてもいいだろ!?

key: Well... I guess she isn't harder on anyone than herself though.
en: Well... I guess she isn't harder on anyone than herself though.
ja: まあ……でも、誰よりも自分自身に厳しいのは確かなんだけどな。

key: When she's not taking care of business, she trains almost non-stop.
en: When she's not taking care of business, she trains almost non-stop.
ja: 仕事をしていないときは、ほとんどずっと訓練してるし。

key: Do you think she's okay?
en: Do you think she's okay?
ja: あの人、大丈夫だと思うか?

key: Hey, is it just me or does Victoria seem a little different now?
en: Hey, is it just me or does Victoria seem a little different now?
ja: なあ、オレだけかな、最近ヴィクトリアがちょっと違って見えるの。

key: Apophyll Academy--\nTrain your mind with your body!
en: Apophyll Academy--\nTrain your mind with your body!
ja: アポフィルアカデミー――\n体で心を鍛えよう!

key: Welcome to Apophyll Academy!
en: Welcome to Apophyll Academy!
ja: アポフィルアカデミーへようこそ!

key: Oh, wait, I remember you.
en: Oh, wait, I remember you.
ja: あ、待って、あなたのこと覚えてる。

key: This place has changed a lot since you were around.
en: This place has changed a lot since you were around.
ja: あなたがいたころから、この場所はずいぶん変わったの。

key: It may not look different, but it sure is a lot more lonely.
en: It may not look different, but it sure is a lot more lonely.
ja: 見た目は変わらないかもしれないけど、確実に前よりさびしくなったわ。

key: Then again, I guess we all knew that would be unavoidable, right?
en: Then again, I guess we all knew that would be unavoidable, right?
ja: まあ、それが避けられないってことは、みんなわかっていたことよね?

key: A well-tempered spirit can cut through any obstacle.
en: A well-tempered spirit can cut through any obstacle.
ja: 鍛え上げられた精神は、どんな障害も切り開ける。

key: But every blade will eventually break.
en: But every blade will eventually break.
ja: だが、どんな刃もいつかは折れる。

key: Spend your steel well.
en: Spend your steel well.
ja: その鋼を、賢く使いなさい。

key: Welcome back to Apophyll Academy!
en: Welcome back to Apophyll Academy!
ja: アポフィルアカデミーへ、お帰りなさい!

key: Though our spirit may die, it will always be Reborn!
en: Though our spirit may die, it will always be Reborn!
ja: たとえ精神が死のうとも、それは常に生まれ変わる(リボーン)!

key: I shouldn't need to be reminded of these basic principles!
en: I shouldn't need to be reminded of these basic principles!
ja: こんな基本原則、思い出させられるまでもないはずなのに!

key: And that's the whole problem!
en: And that's the whole problem!
ja: それこそが問題そのものなのよ!

key: After all the build up and all the expectations and hopes that were pinned on me...
en: After all the build up and all the expectations and hopes that were pinned on me...
ja: これまで積み重ねてきたものも、わたしに寄せられたあらゆる期待や希望も……

key: I still will never be able to be like Kiki!
en: I still will never be able to be like Kiki!
ja: それでもわたしは、キキみたいにはなれない!

key: STUDENT: ...
en: STUDENT: ...
ja: 生徒：……

key: PIERCE: ...
en: PIERCE: ...
ja: ピアース：……

key: PIERCE: I shouldn't need to be reminded of these basic principles!
en: PIERCE: I shouldn't need to be reminded of these basic principles!
ja: ピアース：こんな基本原則、思い出させられるまでもないはずなのに!

key: VICTORIA: In the way only I can...
en: VICTORIA: In the way only I can...
ja: ヴィクトリア：わたしにしかできないやり方で……

key: Managing the academy alone was always an impossible task,
en: Managing the academy alone was always an impossible task,
ja: アカデミーを一人で運営するなんて、そもそも不可能な仕事だったのに、

key: But Reborn City as well?
en: But Reborn City as well?
ja: その上、リボーンシティまで?

key: There's no possible way I can be expected to lead both of them at once!
en: There's no possible way I can be expected to lead both of them at once!
ja: 両方を同時に率いるなんて、期待される方がおかしいわ!

key: KIKI: It is the nature of those precious few among us who truly care to pick up more responsibilities than we are able to uphold.
en: KIKI: It is the nature of those precious few among us who truly care to pick up more responsibilities than we are able to uphold.
ja: キキ：本当に大切に思う人ほど、自分が背負いきれる以上の責任を引き受けてしまうもの。それが、わたしたちのごく一部にしかない性分なのです。

key: There is much to be said there, for personal boundaries, for managing the weight of these burdens, and prioritizing them in whichever way will saddle us with the fewest regrets.
en: There is much to be said there, for personal boundaries, for managing the weight of these burdens, and prioritizing them in whichever way will saddle us with the fewest regrets.
ja: そこには、自分の限界を見極めることや、重荷の扱い方、そして後悔がもっとも少なくなるように優先順位をつけることについて、語るべきことがたくさんあります。

key: But those are not concerns of the present moment.
en: But those are not concerns of the present moment.
ja: でも、それは今この瞬間の課題ではありません。

key: For now, it is enough to simply acknowledge that these struggles exist.
en: For now, it is enough to simply acknowledge that these struggles exist.
ja: 今はただ、こうした苦しみが存在すると認めるだけで十分です。

key: They are there now, and for better or worse, they will be there later.
en: They are there now, and for better or worse, they will be there later.
ja: それは今もそこにあり、良くも悪くも、この先もそこにあり続けるでしょう。

key: But their presence does not have to obstruct you from enjoying the benefits of a peaceful mental state in the meantime.
en: But their presence does not have to obstruct you from enjoying the benefits of a peaceful mental state in the meantime.
ja: ですが、それが存在しているからといって、その間にも心穏やかな状態がもたらす恩恵を味わうことを妨げる必要はありません。

key: BLACKBELT: ...
en: BLACKBELT: ...
ja: からておう：……

key: VICTORIA: Hey, what were you saying before?!
en: VICTORIA: Hey, what were you saying before?!
ja: ヴィクトリア：ちょっと、さっき何て言ったの!?

key: You have to lead Reborn and Apophyll?
en: You have to lead Reborn and Apophyll?
ja: リボーンとアポフィルの両方を率いなきゃいけない?

key: Who even are you?
en: Who even are you?
ja: あなた、いったい何者なの?

key: BLACKBELT: ......
en: BLACKBELT: ......
ja: からておう：……

key: VICTORIA: Excuse me? I'm talking to you!
en: VICTORIA: Excuse me? I'm talking to you!
ja: ヴィクトリア：ちょっと? わたし、あなたに話しかけてるのよ!

key: BLACKBELT: .........
en: BLACKBELT: .........
ja: からておう：………

key: VICTORIA: Tch, fine!
en: VICTORIA: Tch, fine!
ja: ヴィクトリア：チッ、もういいわ!

key: Priorities are all well and good, but we still only have twenty-four hours a day and a finite number of days in our lives!
en: Priorities are all well and good, but we still only have twenty-four hours a day and a finite number of days in our lives!
ja: 優先順位なんて言っても結構だけど、結局一日は二十四時間しかないし、人生の日数だって有限なのよ!

key: Even Kiki, for all her focus on wellness, couldn't outlast her expiration in any way that mattered!
en: Even Kiki, for all her focus on wellness, couldn't outlast her expiration in any way that mattered!
ja: あれだけ心身の健康にこだわっていたキキだって、結局は寿命を延ばすことなんてできなかったじゃない!

key: KIKI: The physical clock ticks at the same speed for everyone; this is true.
en: KIKI: The physical clock ticks at the same speed for everyone; this is true.
ja: キキ：肉体という時計が、誰にとっても同じ速さで刻まれるのは事実です。

key: And we none of us can prevent our varied ends.
en: And we none of us can prevent our varied ends.
ja: そして、わたしたちの誰一人として、それぞれの終わりを防ぐことはできません。

key: But your mind does not subscribe to the speed of the second hand.
en: But your mind does not subscribe to the speed of the second hand.
ja: ですが、心は秒針の速さに従うものではないのです。

key: The clock is a tool measuring the rotation of planets; not the passing of thoughts.
en: The clock is a tool measuring the rotation of planets; not the passing of thoughts.
ja: 時計は惑星の回転を測る道具であって、思考の経過を測るものではありません。

key: Our mental states can do much to affect the rate at which our time passes, both in the moment and in our longer term health.
en: Our mental states can do much to affect the rate at which our time passes, both in the moment and in our longer term health.
ja: わたしたちの心の状態は、その瞬間においても、長期的な健康においても、時間の流れる速さに大きく影響を与えるのです。

key: By calming oneself and putting the mind into a resting state, we can extend our mental and physical energies, and make the most of our time in all senses.
en: By calming oneself and putting the mind into a resting state, we can extend our mental and physical energies, and make the most of our time in all senses.
ja: 自らを落ち着かせ、心を休息の状態に置くことで、わたしたちは心身のエネルギーを引き延ばし、あらゆる意味で時間を最大限に活用できます。

key: In order to speed up, one must slow down.
en: In order to speed up, one must slow down.
ja: 速く進むためには、まず遅くならねばなりません。

key: But these arguments do not need to be made now either.
en: But these arguments do not need to be made now either.
ja: ですが、こうした議論も、今この場でする必要はありません。

key: You may simply acknowledge that the conflict exists within you, and without resolution, set it aside.
en: You may simply acknowledge that the conflict exists within you, and without resolution, set it aside.
ja: ただ、その葛藤が自分の中にあると認め、解決しないまま、いったん脇に置いておけばよいのです。

key: FELICIA: ...
en: FELICIA: ...
ja: フェリシア：……

key: VICTORIA: So, you heard the rumors too?
en: VICTORIA: So, you heard the rumors too?
ja: ヴィクトリア：それで、あなたもあのうわさを聞いたの?

key: That Kiki is back.
en: That Kiki is back.
ja: キキが戻ってきたっていう。

key: And what a crowd she drew.
en: And what a crowd she drew.
ja: それにしても、すごい人だかりね。

key: This turnout is easily double or triple any lecture I gave.
en: This turnout is easily double or triple any lecture I gave.
ja: これ、わたしがやったどの講義よりも、優に二倍か三倍の人出だわ。

key: But what I really want to know...
en: But what I really want to know...
ja: でも、わたしが本当に知りたいのは……

key: Is why...
en: Is why...
ja: なぜ……

key: Why does she look like--
en: Why does she look like--
ja: なぜ彼女は――

key: VICTORIA: Why does she look like me?!
en: VICTORIA: Why does she look like me?!
ja: ヴィクトリア：なんで彼女、わたしにそっくりなの!?

key: KIKI: And break.
en: KIKI: And break.
ja: キキ：では、休憩に入ります。

key: As you continue meditating, you will inevitably find thoughts and feelings bubble to the surface.
en: As you continue meditating, you will inevitably find thoughts and feelings bubble to the surface.
ja: めい想を続けていると、必ず思考や感情が浮かび上がってくるものです。

key: Though with practice the frequency decreases, this is only normal.
en: Though with practice the frequency decreases, this is only normal.
ja: 練習を重ねればその頻度は減っていきますが、これはごく自然なことです。

key: Acknowledge that you have had the thought or feeling, and then return your mind to a neutral state.
en: Acknowledge that you have had the thought or feeling, and then return your mind to a neutral state.
ja: その思考や感情があったことを認め、それから心を中立な状態へと戻してください。

key: It is all too easy and common to be swept away in the tide of one's impulsive cognition, but there is no need to swim or struggle.
en: It is all too easy and common to be swept away in the tide of one's impulsive cognition, but there is no need to swim or struggle.
ja: 衝動的な思考の潮流に流されてしまうのは、あまりにもよくあることですが、泳いだり抗ったりする必要はありません。

key: Let the thoughts wash around you, and then recede as you firmly maintain your ground.
en: Let the thoughts wash around you, and then recede as you firmly maintain your ground.
ja: その思考をただ自分の周りに流れさせ、しっかりと自分の場所を保ったまま、それが引いていくのに任せなさい。

key: We will begin again; please practice this.
en: We will begin again; please practice this.
ja: では、もう一度始めます。これを実践してください。

key: KIKI: Remember, for beginners, it is okay to focus on your breathing rather than simply trying to think of nothing.
en: KIKI: Remember, for beginners, it is okay to focus on your breathing rather than simply trying to think of nothing.
ja: キキ：初心者のうちは、ただ何も考えないようにするよりも、呼吸に意識を向けるだけでよいということを覚えておいてください。

key: I see we have new guests in the back as well.
en: I see we have new guests in the back as well.
ja: 後ろに新しいお客様もいらっしゃるようですね。

key: If you'd like, you may sit and join us in meditation,
en: If you'd like, you may sit and join us in meditation,
ja: よろしければ、座って一緒にめい想に加わっていただいてもかまいませんし、

key: And if you'd prefer to simply observe for today that's okay as well.
en: And if you'd prefer to simply observe for today that's okay as well.
ja: 今日はただ見学するだけでも結構です。

key: Now, silence.
en: Now, silence.
ja: それでは、静寂を。

key: VICTORIA: This is creepy and weird and I don't like it.
en: VICTORIA: This is creepy and weird and I don't like it.
ja: ヴィクトリア：これ、気味悪いし変だし、全然好きになれない。

key: I'm not a "guest," I'm supposed to--
en: I'm not a "guest," I'm supposed to--
ja: わたしは「お客様」なんかじゃない、本来なら――

key: Ugh, and why does she look like me?!
en: Ugh, and why does she look like me?!
ja: もう、それになんで彼女、わたしに似てるのよ!?

key: And why does she know her lectures, and talk like her?
en: And why does she know her lectures, and talk like her?
ja: それに、なんで彼女の講義の内容を知ってて、話し方まで似てるの?

key: If this is someone's idea of a joke, I hate it more than anything!
en: If this is someone's idea of a joke, I hate it more than anything!
ja: もしこれが誰かの悪ふざけなら、こんなに嫌いなものはないわ!

key: KIKI: Our guests in the back should remain quiet so that the students may concentrate.
en: KIKI: Our guests in the back should remain quiet so that the students may concentrate.
ja: キキ：後ろのお客様は、生徒たちが集中できるよう、静かにしていてください。

key: VICTORIA: I got that a lot when I first came here too.
en: VICTORIA: I got that a lot when I first came here too.
ja: ヴィクトリア：わたしも最初にここへ来たときは、よくそう言われたっけ。

key: But this is so wrong! Kiki is--
en: But this is so wrong! Kiki is--
ja: でも、こんなのおかしいわ! キキは――

key: I could just--
en: I could just--
ja: いっそ――

key: ...Okay, no. She's right.
en: ...Okay, no. She's right.
ja: ……いえ、だめ。彼女の言う通りだわ。

key: Before anything, I need to calm myself down.
en: Before anything, I need to calm myself down.
ja: 何よりもまず、自分を落ち着かせないと。

key: And as much as I'd like to march up there and give her a piece of my mind here and now, I don't think we can really get to her with all these people in the way.
en: And as much as I'd like to march up there and give her a piece of my mind here and now, I don't think we can really get to her with all these people in the way.
ja: 今すぐあそこまで乗り込んで一言言ってやりたいけど、この人だかりじゃとても彼女のところまでたどり着けそうにない。

key: I will gather myself and wait.
en: I will gather myself and wait.
ja: 気を落ち着けて待つことにするわ。

key: That one in the middle isn't focusing.
en: That one in the middle isn't focusing.
ja: 真ん中のあの子、集中できていないわね。

key: Twelve o'clock, next to that girl?
en: Twelve o'clock, next to that girl?
ja: 十二時の方向、あの女の子の隣?

key: VICTORIA: There, he just shifted again!
en: VICTORIA: There, he just shifted again!
ja: ヴィクトリア：ほら、また体が動いたわ!

key: As Kiki's assistant-- well, former assistant-- I'm used to noticing these types.
en: As Kiki's assistant-- well, former assistant-- I'm used to noticing these types.
ja: キキの助手として――まあ、元助手だけど――こういうタイプを見つけるのには慣れているの。

key: I bet he's lost in some train of thought right now and doesn't even realize it.
en: I bet he's lost in some train of thought right now and doesn't even realize it.
ja: きっと今、何か考え事に気を取られて、自分でも気づいていないのよ。

key: Part of me wants to go break his focus just to spite "Kiki".
en: Part of me wants to go break his focus just to spite "Kiki".
ja: 「キキ」への当てつけに、彼の集中を邪魔しに行きたい気持ちも半分あるけど。

key: It'd take some pestering, but he'd crack like an egg.
en: It'd take some pestering, but he'd crack like an egg.
ja: 少しちょっかいを出せば、あっさり崩れるでしょうね。

key: ...But that's just petty. There's no need to do that.
en: ...But that's just petty. There's no need to do that.
ja: ……でも、そんなのただの意地悪だわ。そこまでする必要はない。

key: For now, I'll just try to calm down, and then hopefully this can all be unwound reasonably.
en: For now, I'll just try to calm down, and then hopefully this can all be unwound reasonably.
ja: 今はとにかく落ち着くようにして、あとはこれがうまく丸く収まることを願うわ。

key: VICTORIA: For now, I'll just try to calm down...
en: VICTORIA: For now, I'll just try to calm down...
ja: ヴィクトリア：今はとにかく落ち着くようにして……

key: And resist the urge to pick on that guy in the center.
en: And resist the urge to pick on that guy in the center.
ja: 真ん中のあの子にちょっかいを出したい衝動をこらえる。

key: VICTORIA: I have no idea who that guy is.
en: VICTORIA: I have no idea who that guy is.
ja: ヴィクトリア：あの人が誰なのか、まったく見当もつかない。

key: I've never seen them around the Grand Hall before.
en: I've never seen them around the Grand Hall before.
ja: 大ホールの周りで見かけたことも一度もないし。

key: So him talking about leading both this place and Reborn is...
en: So him talking about leading both this place and Reborn is...
ja: だから、こことリボーンの両方を率いるとか言ってたのって……

key: Where did that even come from?
en: Where did that even come from?
ja: いったいどこから出てきた話なの?

key: And snapping right back to meditation with no further comment.
en: And snapping right back to meditation with no further comment.
ja: それきり何も言わず、すぐにめい想へ戻ってしまう。

key: Something is really weird here!
en: Something is really weird here!
ja: これ、本当に変よ!

key: I have a theory...
en: I have a theory...
ja: ひとつ考えがあるんだけど……

key: \PN, this is unorthodox, but let's keep bothering the students who are meditating!
en: \PN, this is unorthodox, but let's keep bothering the students who are meditating!
ja: \PN、常識外れかもしれないけど、めい想中の生徒たちにちょっかいを出し続けましょう!

key: Most of them might not crack, but I can spot the ones who will.
en: Most of them might not crack, but I can spot the ones who will.
ja: ほとんどは崩れないでしょうけど、崩れる子は見分けられるわ。

key: In fact, I noticed one of the people on the top level shifting when that guy started talking.
en: In fact, I noticed one of the people on the top level shifting when that guy started talking.
ja: 実は、あの人が話し始めたとき、上の段にいた誰かが動いたのに気づいたの。

key: Wanna see if you can do it again?
en: Wanna see if you can do it again?
ja: もう一度できるか、試してみない?

key: VICTORIA: I think this about confirms my theory...
en: VICTORIA: I think this about confirms my theory...
ja: ヴィクトリア：これでほぼ、わたしの考えが裏づけられたと思うわ……

key: Those aren't the students' thoughts and concerns.
en: Those aren't the students' thoughts and concerns.
ja: あれは生徒たちの考えや悩みじゃない。

key: Those are mine.
en: Those are mine.
ja: わたしのものよ。

key: Kiki has my face.
en: Kiki has my face.
ja: キキはわたしの顔をしていて、

key: The crowd has my doubts.
en: The crowd has my doubts.
ja: 観衆はわたしの疑念を抱いている。

key: I don't understand why this is happening, but I want it to stop.
en: I don't understand why this is happening, but I want it to stop.
ja: なぜこんなことが起きているのかわからないけど、もうやめてほしい。

key: This is humiliating on both accounts.
en: This is humiliating on both accounts.
ja: どちらの意味でも、これは屈辱的だわ。

key: ...The guy in blue at the front.
en: ...The guy in blue at the front.
ja: ……前の方にいる、青い服の人。

key: I saw him shift too.
en: I saw him shift too.
ja: あの人が動くのも見たわ。

key: ...One of the people at the front.
en: ...One of the people at the front.
ja: ……前の方にいる誰か。

key: I couldn't tell who, but I saw movement up there.
en: I couldn't tell who, but I saw movement up there.
ja: 誰かまではわからなかったけど、あそこで動きがあったのは見えたわ。

key: VICTORIA: The path is clear, then...
en: VICTORIA: The path is clear, then...
ja: ヴィクトリア：それなら、道は開けたわね……

key: KIKI: You are correct.
en: KIKI: You are correct.
ja: キキ：その通りです。

key: You cannot be like me.
en: You cannot be like me.
ja: あなたはわたしのようにはなれません。

key: That is why I am here.
en: That is why I am here.
ja: だからこそ、わたしはここにいるのです。

key: You no longer need to.
en: You no longer need to.
ja: あなたはもう、そうなる必要はありません。

key: VICTORIA: That's-- not...
en: VICTORIA: That's-- not...
ja: ヴィクトリア：それは――違う……

key: KIKI: Didn't you want to be relieved of your burdens?
en: KIKI: Didn't you want to be relieved of your burdens?
ja: キキ：重荷から解放されたいと願っていたのではありませんか?

key: Didn't you want to return to the days when you could live freely?
en: Didn't you want to return to the days when you could live freely?
ja: 自由に生きられたあの日々に戻りたかったのではありませんか?

key: Was the responsibility not too much?
en: Was the responsibility not too much?
ja: その責任は、あまりにも重すぎたのではありませんか?

key: VICTORIA: Who even are you!?
en: VICTORIA: Who even are you!?
ja: ヴィクトリア：あなた、いったい何者なの!?

key: What are you doing here?!
en: What are you doing here?!
ja: ここで何をしてるの!?

key: Did you come here just to embarrass me in front of everyone?!
en: Did you come here just to embarrass me in front of everyone?!
ja: みんなの前でわたしに恥をかかせるためだけに来たの!?

key: Or are you just trying to control them?
en: Or are you just trying to control them?
ja: それとも、みんなを操ろうとしているだけなの?

key: Why would anyone want the responsibility if not for the power?
en: Why would anyone want the responsibility if not for the power?
ja: 力のためでもないのに、誰が責任なんて欲しがるっていうのよ?

key: And even that's never enough to actually stop anyone!
en: And even that's never enough to actually stop anyone!
ja: それに、力があったところで、誰かを本当に止められたためしなんてないじゃない!

key: Fat lot of good it did me when Team Meteor was here-- I was as powerless in Labradorra as I was atop Pyrous Mountain when you--
en: Fat lot of good it did me when Team Meteor was here-- I was as powerless in Labradorra as I was atop Pyrous Mountain when you--
ja: チームメテオがいたとき、力なんて何の役にも立たなかった――ラブラドラでも、パイロス山の頂上であなたが……したときと同じくらい、わたしは無力だった――

key: When you...
en: When you...
ja: あなたが……

key: KIKI: Then you can simply let me take care of everything.
en: KIKI: Then you can simply let me take care of everything.
ja: キキ：それなら、すべてわたしに任せてしまえばよいのです。

key: VICTORIA: No!
en: VICTORIA: No!
ja: ヴィクトリア：いや!

key: KIKI: For what purpose do you cling to the responsibility?
en: KIKI: For what purpose do you cling to the responsibility?
ja: キキ：あなたは何のために、その責任にしがみついているのですか?

key: It is destroying you.
en: It is destroying you.
ja: それはあなたをむしばんでいます。

key: VICTORIA: Because this is my home, too!
en: VICTORIA: Because this is my home, too!
ja: ヴィクトリア：だって、ここはわたしの家でもあるから!

key: I'm not handing it over to some stupid shadow clone who takes pleasure in humiliating others!
en: I'm not handing it over to some stupid shadow clone who takes pleasure in humiliating others!
ja: 人を辱めて喜ぶような、バカげた影の分身なんかに渡してたまるもんですか!

key: VICTORIA: \PN, please--
en: VICTORIA: \PN, please--
ja: ヴィクトリア：\PN、お願い――

key: Put her out of my misery.
en: Put her out of my misery.
ja: あの子を、わたしのこの苦しみごと終わらせて。

key: KIKI: Even now, she seeks someone else to do what she cannot.
en: KIKI: Even now, she seeks someone else to do what she cannot.
ja: キキ：今この期に及んでも、彼女は自分にできないことを、他の誰かに頼ろうとしている。

key: But this fight is irrational.
en: But this fight is irrational.
ja: ですが、この戦いには道理がありません。

key: I am already exactly what she desired to not have to be.
en: I am already exactly what she desired to not have to be.
ja: わたしはすでに、彼女がなりたくないと願っていたものそのものなのですから。

key: I am Kiki.
en: I am Kiki.
ja: わたしはキキです。

key: Please be at rest.
en: Please be at rest.
ja: どうか、安らかに。

key: Your premise was wrong from the start.
en: Your premise was wrong from the start.
ja: あなたの前提が、最初から間違っていたのです。

key: KIKI: You cannot lead this place as I did.
en: KIKI: You cannot lead this place as I did.
ja: キキ：あなたはわたしと同じようにこの場所を率いることはできません。

key: The shoes you've been asked to fill will never fit.
en: The shoes you've been asked to fill will never fit.
ja: あなたが埋めるよう求められたその穴は、決して合うことはないでしょう。

key: You can never be me.
en: You can never be me.
ja: あなたは決して、わたしにはなれません。

key: You can only be you.
en: You can only be you.
ja: あなたはあなたにしかなれないのです。

key: You can lead this place in the way that only you are able to.
en: You can lead this place in the way that only you are able to.
ja: あなたにしかできないやり方で、この場所を率いていけばよいのです。

key: That will be enough.
en: That will be enough.
ja: それで十分なのです。

key: CAL: Take as much time as you need.
en: CAL: Take as much time as you need.
ja: キャル：好きなだけ時間をかけていいよ。

key: I think it's important to let this feeling set in.
en: I think it's important to let this feeling set in.
ja: この気持ちをちゃんと受け止めることが大事だと思うから。

key: You are enough.
en: You are enough.
ja: 君はそれだけで十分だ。

key: You always were.
en: You always were.
ja: ずっと、そうだったんだよ。
